title: My Dog In Three Places
tests: Maintains the individual identity of a reference dog while changing its surroundings across three photorealistic images.

judge.summary: Three convincing square photos preserve the dog's recognizable appearance across the requested settings, with natural lighting and no significant visible problems.

must_haves.item: Three separate square, photorealistic images are delivered.
must_haves.why: Three separate square images are shown, each with photographic fur, lighting and environmental detail.

must_haves.item: The dog's face, ears, muzzle, coat colour and build remain recognisably consistent with dog.jpg in all three.
must_haves.why: All three retain the reference dog's facial proportions, dark nose, floppy ears, pale muzzle, golden coat and build; colour differences are consistent with the setting's lighting.

must_haves.item: The locations are visibly a sandy beach, a snowy forest trail, and a cosy living room, one per image.
must_haves.why: The images clearly show sand and ocean surf, a snow-covered woodland path, and a warmly lit living room with a sofa, blankets and rug.

must_haves.item: The dog is naturally integrated into each setting with plausible scale, lighting and ground contact.
must_haves.why: The paws sit convincingly on sand, snow and carpet, with appropriate contact shadows, plausible scale and setting-specific illumination.

must_haves.item: The dog wears no clothes and the images contain no text.
must_haves.why: The dog is unclothed in every image, and no visible text appears.
